moments.text: Black screen; the picture fades in from about 3.9 s.
Night phone video over flat dark ground with small red and white lights along the horizon. A bright point of light above it fans broad pale rays upward.
The view sways; a dark shape, then a person's head, edges into the lower right corner while the light and its rays hold above the horizon.
The camera zooms in: the light becomes a small white oval at the base of the fan of rays, with red lights on the horizon below.
The picture fades to black by 13.6 s and stays black to the end.
